text: Da igual que reinstale, cierre la aplicación del todo, reinicie el móvil... la aplicación se queda en una pantalla en la que me pide que active unas notificaciones y aunque le de a continuar no hace nada más. Cancelo la suscripción.
author: Aetherys
developer_reply:
We’re sorry you’re experiencing this issue. This isn’t the experience we want for our users.

Kindly reach out to us at hello@getinflow.io so we can help troubleshoot and resolve the problem. We want to make sure this gets fixed for you.

text: parece una aplicación muy útil pero es absurdo que quieran cobrar más de 50€/mes o 229€ al año

text: Fraudulent! Charged my card $199 without warning. No way to contact them, no option to cancel my profile. Do not sign up!
author: Sarah A
developer_reply: I'm sorry to hear about this experience. We take these matters seriously. Please email us at hello@getinflow.io so we can address this issue promptly. Your satisfaction is important to us.

text: Intenté instalar la aplicación, pero es imposible pasar de la fase donde se pone el correo, cuando intenté validar el correo se pegó y ya no pude despegarla. Una lastima porque realmente quería probarla
author: Azana surok
developer_reply: We're sorry to hear you've had some technical issues with the App. If you are having issues signing up or need assistance at all, please reach out to our support team at hello@getinflow.io and we can get it sorted for you promptly.

text: Te cobran automáticamente si olvidas cancelar después del free trial, me parece horrible que hagan eso en especial a gente con adhd, no tienen escrúpulos. Sali corriendo cuando vi que debía aceptar esa política, eso es pura maldad. Ojalá les vaya pésimo.
author: Dena Main
developer_reply: Thanks for your review. We offer a 7-day free trial before you have to pay anything and send reminder emails to let you know when your trial is ending. We also offer a Access Program where 20% of members receive access to the app for free for a year! More info can be found on our FAQ page or by reaching out to us at hello@getinflow.io.

author: Cristián
developer_reply: Hi Cristián, thanks for your review. We're sorry to hear that you didn't have a good experience with Inflow. If you have any more detail about your issue, please reach out to us at hello@getinflow.io so we can assist you.

text: It's a pity it's not in spanish
author: Mon Trig
developer_reply: Hi there, thank you for your review and providing feedback. We're sorry that the App is not currently available in your preferred language. This may be something we can look into in the future. If you have any other suggestions, or questions, please do reach out to us at hello@getinflow.io :)

text: User friendly, motivating and tailored to the needs of adults with ADHD. The modules allow you to work on your problem areas, and you can set your own pace and connect and work with other users. La única pega, es que está sólo en inglés.
author: Maria Jose Garcia Quijano
developer_reply: Hi Maria, thanks so much for the review. We're so glad to hear you've found Inflow to be a useful tool! If you have any other feedback, please feel free to reach out to us at hello@getinflow.io!
